concepts.label: Getting Cluster Statistics REST API (metric/function/label query surface)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the Prometheus-backed REST API queried by metric/function/label, distinct from stats:cluster-statistics (this batch's mint for the older, unrelated /pools/default REST surface documented on manage-statistics.md). Server's own statistics/monitoring vocabulary genuinely does not fit the promoted, Capella-specific monitoring: family (activity log/alerts/health-advisor/event severity enums) - this is a different, metrics-and-Prometheus-shaped surface entirely, so kept in the new stats: namespace rather than forced into monitoring:.

notable_absence.finding: This intro page never cross-links back to manage-statistics.md's own REST section (/pools/default, /buckets/<name>/stats) even though both pages document Server statistics REST surfaces - a reader following only this page's 'Monitoring with the REST API' section would never learn the older /pools/default endpoint exists at all, and vice versa from manage-statistics.md.

cross_component_finding: This page is the first point in the batch where Server's OWN statistics/monitoring vocabulary (metric/function/label, per-node Prometheus instance) is stated as genuinely distinct from the /pools/default REST surface manage-statistics.md documents - two parallel statistics REST APIs for the same underlying data, one older ('Getting Bucket Statistics'/'Retrieving Cluster Information') and one Prometheus-backed ('Getting Cluster Statistics'), confirming the round's hypothesis that Server's own monitoring vocabulary needed new, non-Capella concepts rather than reuse of monitoring:.
